success.description: The affected suit of armour is considered an enchanted and blessed item of superior quality. Its soak value may not be ignored by effects that normally ignore armour soak value, and the Pierce value of any attack that targets the wearer is reduced by 2.

boon.description: The armour’s defence value is increased by 1.

success.description: Effect: Myrmidia blesses your armour. While this blessing is recharging, the affected suit of armour is considered an enchanted and blessed item of superior quality. Its soak value may not be ignored by effects that normally ignore armour soak value, and the Pierce value of any attack that targets the wearer is reduced by 2.

boon.description: The armour’s wearer gains the Inspired condition while this blessing is recharging.
